display.title: Episode 357: The Return of Yehudah, Chapter 2
display.summary_short: Join the Shiviti Club, a Beis Yaakov class says the Shema, the cruel poritz throws Reb Moshe's family into a pit, and the Baal Shem Tov's example of Ahavas Yisroel.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi launches the Shiviti Club: draw and decorate a Shiviti Hashem l'negdi samid sign, hang it where you will see it on waking, since Hashem never sleeps, and send it in with a photo for the newsletter. After the Hakochainik march, a class from a Brooklyn girls' school leads the Shema. Story time continues The Return of Yehudah: Reb Moshe cannot pay the doubled rent, and the cruel poritz takes him, Sarah and baby Yehudah in his coach to a deep pit, leaving them there until townspeople throw down enough coins to pay. In the mailbox, a young listener writes how much the program inspires her and connects last week's teaching about darkness to Yaakov Avinu establishing Maariv. Uncle Yossi then tells how the Baal Shem Tov, as a hidden tzaddik, carried little children through the mud to cheder, and explains from Rashi that Avraham, and every Jew, was given the power to bless others; listeners bless a sick child. The show ends with an invitation to sign up friends for Tzivos Hashem, Friday's candle time and Dial-a-Jewish-Story.
display.lesson: Love every Jew like the Baal Shem Tov did: use your power to bless others, and remember that Hashem is always before you.
